title: Spyglass Officially Launched
summary: We are excited to announce that Spyglass has officially launched from beta, delivering its powerful capabilities and refined experience to all users.

title: Enhanced File & Media Management
summary: Effortlessly manage your embedded images and documents with an intuitive new interface, allowing you to upload, organize, and customize their appearance in your content.

title: Introducing Our Public Product Roadmap
summary: We're excited to introduce our new public roadmap, providing a clear overview of our past accomplishments, current priorities, and future plans to enhance your experience.

title: Enhanced Checkbox Experience
summary: Enjoy a more intuitive and visually appealing task management experience with our new checkboxes, now easier to click, drag, and seamlessly integrated into our modern design.

title: Enhanced Real-time Collaboration
summary: Enjoy a significantly upgraded real-time collaboration experience, designed to bring effortless teamwork and crystal-clear awareness to your shared projects.

title: Enhanced Collaboration and Shared Item Discovery
summary: Users can now effortlessly discover and collaborate on shared content, enhancing teamwork and productivity.

title: Global Language Support
summary: Noeko is expanding its horizons to welcome users worldwide with comprehensive international language support.

title: Noeko is Now Open Source
summary: Noeko's codebase is now open source, empowering you with maximum control, direct involvement in its evolution, and complete transparency.

title: Dynamic Connection Explorer
summary: Uncover hidden insights and kickstart your workflows with an enhanced Constellation view, featuring dynamic filters for tags, time, and shared connections.

title: Refined Search and Dynamic Collections
summary: Discover and organize your information with unparalleled precision by applying advanced filters and sorting, then effortlessly save these refined searches as dynamic collections for instant access.

title: Dynamic Linked Content Views
summary: Gain greater clarity and control over your connected notes with dynamic new display modes that offer enhanced interactivity and intuitive structuring.

title: Noeko Unleashed: Self-Hosted Freedom and Flexible Plans
summary: Experience unparalleled control and security by hosting Noeko on your own infrastructure, complemented by new flexible plans designed to empower both individual users and growing enterprises.

title: Transform Your Look with New and Improved Themes
summary: Experience a refreshed interface with improved existing themes and an array of brand-new stylish options to customize your workspace.

title: Enhanced Time-Sensitive Greetings
summary: We're ensuring our homepage greetings always reflect the correct time of day, providing a more personalized and seamless experience for every user.

title: Effortless Tag Management
summary: Gain powerful control over your organization by instantly removing multiple items from a tag or managing associated entries, all directly within the tag's list view.

title: Unlock Diverse Content Sources
summary: Get ready to import a wider array of content, including YouTube videos, entire websites, and various text formats, transforming how you capture and interact with information.
